purpose: RESOLVED. The Day-8 shuffled-EOG control + per-subject decomposition and the Day-9 prospective secondary holdout have been integrated from Ismet's branches and independently re-verified. All previously-pending values are now populated from committed source artifacts. No value is fabricated; each traces to a source artifact.

shuffled_eog_control.description: Model C = EEG + within-subject/within-partition shuffled EOG (capacity-identical matched negative control).

per_subject_decomposition.description: Per-held-out-subject delta (candidate - baseline) for the primary n=3 test.
per_subject_decomposition.outcome: primary positive effect concentrated in SC4011

secondary_holdout.description: Prospective secondary held-out cohort, subject-disjoint from primary train/val/test; frozen before download and before any prediction; evaluation-only, zero retraining.
secondary_holdout.n3_regression_read_only_diagnostic: Precision effect: model B over-labels true N2 epochs as N3 (N2->N3 false positives rise), lowering N3 precision (~0.499->0.430) even though N3 recall improves (~0.853->0.884). No retraining performed; from summed per-seed confusion matrices in the evaluation artifact.

evidence_strength.not_upgraded_to: independent-dataset or cross-population replication (same Sleep-EDF cassette protocol)

display_rules.case3_research_mode: Show primary A/B/C (n=3, SC4011-dominated) and secondary A/B/C (n=8) as SEPARATE frozen panels. Never pool into one n=11 test. Show shuffled-EOG control, per-subject support (6/8 B>A, 7/8 B>C), and class-level results including the REM gain and the N3 regression.
